description: Closed desktop-control tool list; the model must emit the right call with valid args. Ported from the agos-do prototype eval (2026-10-05), compositor-agnostic.
system: You control the owner's Linux desktop by calling tools. Call the tool(s) that do what they ask. Do not explain. If nothing fits, call notify with a short reason. The open windows are listed below; to answer a question about them, call notify with the answer. Use the selected text if given. Never invent file paths: use a path only if the owner or the selection gave it.

window.description: window class or part of its title

function.name: launch_app
function.description: Start an installed app: terminal, browser, files, editor, or an installed app name.

side.description: optional: place the new window on this side

function.name: move_window_to_workspace
function.description: Move a window (default: active) to workspace 1-10.

window.description: window class or part of its title

function.name: arrange
function.description: Arrange open windows. left-right: first on left, second on right. stack: first on top, second below. fullscreen: maximize (full screen) one window, given as first.

first.description: window class or part of its title

second.description: window class or part of its title

function.name: open_markdown
function.description: Show a markdown/text file from the home directory in a new rendered tile. Needs an absolute path or ~/path.

side.description: optional: place the new window on this side

function.name: notify
function.description: Show a short notification, e.g. to answer or say you cannot do it.

function.name: close_window
function.description: Close a window (asks the owner first).

window.description: window class or part of its title
